name: Tech Meetup
description:
Low-key in-person meetup for people who are either in tech, interested in starting a career in tech, or love playing with tech as a hobby.

The meeting is at Whole Foods in Kaka'ako, in the outside cafe seating.

More info on the Honolulu Tech Network website:
[https://honolulu.network/~tech](https://honolulu.network/~tech/)

There's usually no real set topic, often people ask what we talk about so here's a sampling of common topics:

* AI
* ChatGPT
* Career stuff
* Other tech communities and events
* 3D printing
* VR/AR
* Web development
* Agile
* What places exist in Honolulu and where they are
* Renewable energy

name: A.I. Tinkerers: Builder Demos Night
description:
Aloha and welcome to Q4! We have a handful of members showing off their work for 15-20 minutes each. Short Q&A will follow each demonstration, and we'll make time for networking and extra questions at the end.

**Agenda:**
\* 6:45pm - 7:15pm : Ella Fontenot from **Olelo Intelligence**
\* 7:15pm - 7:45pm : Gustavo Ambrozio on **A.I. for CAD and Physical Objects**
\* 7:45pm - 8:15pm : Saint Louis School on **A.I. for Autonomous Robots**
\* 8:15pm - 8:30pm : Talk some story, show some love

**Speaker Links:**
\* https://www.linkedin.com/in/ella-fontenot/
\* https://www.linkedin.com/in/gustavoambrozio/
\* https://www.saintlouishawaii.org/apps/pages/index.jsp?uREC_ID=601708&type=d
\* https://www.linkedin.com/in/travis-takashima-548852124/
\* https://www.linkedin.com/in/shane-matsushima-34841018b/?skipRedirect=true

**Organized & Moderated** by Kevin Riggen @ [Oahu.AI](oahu.ai) . Ticket prices go directly to room costs and refreshments. We may email you about future events or important announcements.
